---
title: "1 · Ranking under uncertainty"
---

Ranking estimates is affected by sampling variation and differences in precision. The
[simulation of noisy estimates](noisy-league.qmd) examines their effects on extreme ranks. Posterior distributions
provide information about individual values and pairwise order, illustrated first for
[two units](two-units.qmd) and then in the [pairwise probability matrix](pairwise-matrix.qmd).
Subsequent applications distinguish ranking summaries, count their expected incorrect statements and examine
Monte Carlo error. These quantities provide the inputs for [ordered grade reporting](../grades/index.qmd).
